references.text: Parallel account in Judges where Akhsa asks her father Caleb for a blessing and receives water springs, with almost identical wording
The context where Caleb gives Akhsa to Othniel as a wife after he captured Kiriath-Sepher, leading to her request
The immediate context describing Caleb's inheritance, Othniel's conquest, and the marriage to Akhsa
Jacob asks for a blessing (berakhah), the same Hebrew word used by Akhsa when she requests a gift from her father
Description of the Negev region where the Amalekites lived, relevant to Akhsa's mention of the land of the Negev
Joshua conquers the Negev area, background for the territory Akhsa refers to
